title: Vitreomacular Interface Abnormalities in Diabetic Retinopathy Using OCT
brief_summary: to evaluate vitreomacular interface abnormalities in diabetic retinopathy by using Ocular Coherence Tomography (OCT)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diabetic patient with or without treatment and with or without evidence of vitreomacular traction on clinical examination

Exclusion Criteria:

* diabetic patient with unclear media as dense cataract,
* vitreous Hemorrhage and corneal opacity
study_population: diabetic male and female patient with age between 12 and 70 years who live in Asiut city
condition: on Vitreomacular Interface Abnormalities in Diabetic Retinopathy
